If the number is even, until end of turn, red creatures get -N/-N and if a player taps a Mountain for mana, that Mountain produces colorless mana instead of any other type.
failing_piece: count the number of permanents. If the number is odd, until end of turn, red creatures get +1/+1 and whenever a player taps a Mountain for mana, that player adds an additional {R}.
note: drilled: the parity condition "if the number of permanents is odd, until end of turn, red creatures get +1/+1" compiles (C6-cm-7, C6-cm-8; Chaos Lord's "if the number of permanents is even"), and each effect compiles alone under the trigger (C6-cm-10, C6-cm-11, C6-cm-12: the pump, the additional {R} mana trigger, Pale Moon's "it produces colorless mana instead"); "count the number of permanents. If the number is odd, ..." fails with any body (C6-cm-1, C6-cm-5, C6-cm-9): the step "count the number of X" and "the number" as its referent (Touch of the Eternal, Invincible Hymn and Rumbling Ruin compile "count ..." followed by "that number"); second piece: two effects joined by "and" under one "until end of turn" fail (C6-cm-2, C6-cm-4), and so does the referent "that Mountain" for the tapped land (C6-cm-3). Grammar over existing engine support; no new engine feature.

failing_piece: create a colorless Equipment artifact token named Rock with "Equipped creature has '{1}, {T}, Sacrifice Rock: This creature deals 2 damage to any target'" and equip {1}.
note: drilled: the same token with "Sacrifice this artifact" compiles (C6-tog-1), and "Sacrifice this token" on a plain artifact token compiles (C6-tog-5); the token's own name as a self-reference fails nested (C6-tog-3) and unnested (C6-tog-2, C6-tog-4): a created token's given name in its own (or its granted) ability means that token (CR 201.5, 201.5a; CR 111.4 the name the effect gives). Search: "named (\w+) with "...Sacrifice \1" over in-scope paper cards finds only Toggo (Kwia Vigorbloom, Kibo, Everquill Phoenix and the Axe/Sword makers say "this token"/"this artifact"), but the fix is a normalization rule of the compiler (a token's given name inside its quoted abilities is the self-name, like a card's own name), not a card construct: compile it, don't hand-write it.
